title: [Paeoniflorin alleviates cancer-related fatigue during chemotherapy for breast cancer by targeting EZH2/CCNE1 to regulate cell cycle and inflammatory microenvironment].
authors: Li, Zhuang; Shi, Huan; Chen, Jieting; Liang, Yuqi; Wu, Yingchao; Zuo, Qian; Chen, Qianjun
journal: Nan fang yi ke da xue xue bao = Journal of Southern Medical University
one_liner_zh: 该文研究芍药苷缓解乳腺癌化疗相关疲劳的分子机制，聚焦EZH2/CCNE1调控细胞周期与炎症微环境，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: To explore the molecular mechanisms and key pharmacodynamic basis of Baishao for alleviating cancer-related fatigue (CRF) during chemotherapy for breast cancer. METHODS: Bioinformatics analyses were used to explore the active ingredients and potential targets of Baishao, CRF-related targets, and the differentially expressed core genes between chemotherapy and non-chemotherapy groups. Four machine learning algorithms (Random Forest, SVM, XGBoost, and GLM) were used to screen the key feature genes to construct a diagnostic nomogram model with subsequent survival and immunohistochemical analyses using Kaplan-Meier Plotter and HPA databases. In an IL-17-induced Py230 breast cancer cell model of CRF, the regulatory effects of paeoniflorin (a major active ingredient of Baishao) on the core targets were validated using CCK-8 assay, qRT-PCR, Western blotting, and immunofluorescence staining. RESULTS: Thirteen active ingredients (including paeoniflorin, albiflorin, and kaempferol) and 475 drug targets of Baishao were identified, yielding 65 core intersection genes enriched in the MAPK signaling cascade, circadian rhythm, and cell cycle regulation and showing significant correlations with immune cells. The SVM model demonstrated the best diagnostic performance and identified PSMB8, EZH2, CCNE1, PSEN2, and CDK1 as the key feature genes. The SVM-based nomogram achieved a C-index of 0.911, showing excellent calibration and clinical net benefit. Molecular docking confirmed strong binding affinities between the core ingredients of Baishao and the key targets. Survival analysis linked high EZH2 and CCNE1 expressions to poor breast cancer prognosis. In IL-17-induced Py230 cells, chemotherapy resulted in significant upregulation of EZH2 and CCNE1 expressions, which were effectively reversed by paeoniflorin treatment with an efficacy comparable to specific positive inhibitors. CONCLUSIONS: Paeoniflorin alleviates chemotherapy-induced CRF in breast cancer by targeting and inhibiting abnormal expressions of EZH2 and CCNE1 to regulate cell cycle and inflammatory microenvironment, highlighting the therapeutic potential of Baishao for attenuating toxicity and enhancing efficacy of chemotherapy.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨白芍缓解乳腺癌化疗期间癌因性疲乏（CRF）的分子机制及关键药效物质基础。方法：采用生物信息学分析探讨白芍的活性成分及潜在靶点、CRF相关靶点，以及化疗与非化疗组间差异表达的核心基因。利用四种机器学习算法（随机森林、SVM、XGBoost和GLM）筛选关键特征基因，构建诊断列线图模型，并利用Kaplan-Meier Plotter和HPA数据库进行生存及免疫组化分析。在IL-17诱导的Py230乳腺癌细胞CRF模型中，通过CCK-8实验、qRT-PCR、Western blotting和免疫荧光染色验证芍药苷（白芍主要活性成分）对核心靶点的调控作用。结果：鉴定出白芍的13种活性成分（包括芍药苷、白芍苷和山柰酚）及475个药物靶点，得到65个核心交集基因，富集于MAPK信号级联、昼夜节律和细胞周期调控，并与免疫细胞显著相关。SVM模型表现出最佳诊断性能，并鉴定出PSMB8、EZH2、CCNE1、PSEN2和CDK1为关键特征基因。基于SVM的列线图C指数为0.911，显示出优异的校准度和临床净获益。分子对接证实白芍核心成分与关键靶点间具有强结合亲和力。生存分析将EZH2和CCNE1高表达与乳腺癌不良预后相关联。在IL-17诱导的Py230细胞中，化疗导致EZH2和CCNE1表达显著上调，而芍药苷处理有效逆转了这种上调，其效果与特异性阳性抑制剂相当。结论：芍药苷通过靶向并抑制EZH2和CCNE1的异常表达，调控细胞周期和炎症微环境，从而缓解乳腺癌化疗诱导的CRF，凸显了白芍在化疗减毒增效方面的治疗潜力。
